name: Kiri Tamati
bio:
Kiri's journey into motorsport started young, fueled by weekends spent at local speedway tracks near her hometown. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Auckland, she dove straight into the racing world, initially as a data analyst for a V8 Supercars team. Her sharp analytical skills and ability to quickly identify performance gains led to a promotion to performance engineer within a few years.

Kiri thrives under pressure and is known for her meticulous approach to car setup. She believes in a collaborative environment, working closely with drivers and mechanics to extract every last bit of performance. Her innovative thinking has led to several crucial breakthroughs that resulted in significant lap time improvements. She's a firm believer that small, incremental changes can add up to a big advantage, and is always looking for new ways to push the boundaries.

What distinguishes Kiri is her ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner, bridging the gap between the engineering room and the driver's seat. She's also fiercely loyal and dedicated to her team's success, often putting in extra hours to ensure everything is perfect.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick, usually tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Kiri is of average height with a strong, athletic build from years of competitive swimming.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations and notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, even in the chaotic environment of the paddock.
